_comments._scope: Read by scripts/estimate_kstar.py only. measure_file.py, plot_instance.py, plot_summary.py and algorithm_comparison.py resolve their paths themselves and ignore this file. The paths below stay relative to the project root, not to scripts/.
_comments.results_csv: Base path of the measurement record: every results/type<T>/<label>/measurements*.csv beside it is read.
_comments.estimates_csv: Where the k* summary is written; estimate_details.json lands next to it.
_comments.gate_seconds: Lower bound: only GB times above this are used for the fit (overhead-free).
_comments.fit_floor_abs_s: Absolute floor in seconds below which a point counts as overhead, not signal.
_comments.fit_floor_rel: Relative floor: this many times the fastest measured time. The fit uses max(fit_floor_abs_s, fit_floor_rel x fastest).
_comments.full_types: Types getting the full fit + extrapolation (interior k*). Every other type is reported from its measured points only.
